name: Rakia
source:
Estimated Age: Around 28 years old

A freelance courier who takes jobs at "Cafe Tsukikage".
A resourceful person who can drive any kind of vehicle, and if he's requested he can get any person or thing to any destination. 
He may look like a person who only thinks of the future, but he has a surprisingly emotional side.
